Name: Luxurious Large Villa for farmhouse
Author: YellowSlime233
Description:
[size=3]豪华大别墅的农舍版本，现在你的配偶和宠物还有孩子可以在里面居住了！[/size]

[size=3]大体与PIF版本一致，但有[/size][color=#ff7700][b]以下差别[/b][/color][size=3]:[/size]

[size=3]1.删去了path层的草与树还有灌木(因为每次房屋升级时path层会移位并多出来一层)[/size]
[size=3]2.为雨天，下雪天新增了背景差分[/size]
[size=3]3.删去了温室属性和可建造农场建筑属性，水域不再可以钓鱼。[/size]
[size=3]4.因为有其他玩家反馈之前的整张地图在家具过多时会严重卡顿，所以将农舍拆成了4个部分，随着农舍等级提升逐步额外解锁新地图.[/size]
[size=3]5.新增两种着色方式,一种更深一些，另一种则是浅色.[/size]

[b][color=#ff7700]注意，本模组将所有配偶的房间进行了些许修正来适配房间结构，如果你同时使用了其他配偶房相关的更改模组，可以在配置选项中将本模组的配偶房更改停止启用。[/color][/b]

[size=3]农舍已经对PolyamorySweet作出兼容，当你同时使用PolyamorySweet时，在婚后会呈现专属的兼容地图，这个兼容地图可以最多容纳6个配偶房(从美观设计和地图宽度限制所以我预留了6个位置)。在下方的湖里可以通过木船传送到海滩(可以反向传送回来)，并在旁边的爱心岛上添加了一个矿车传送点。[/size]

[size=3]如果你不使用PolyamorySweet，将会沿用常规的样式。[/size]

[size=3]每一级农舍升级都会解锁新区域的传送点和区域:[/size]
[size=3]    2级农舍(可以结婚):解锁向上通往2楼的楼梯，还有右上角的露台。[/size]
[size=3]    3级农舍(可以生孩子):解锁2楼通往3楼的楼梯，露台旁边的婴儿室，以及为电梯预留的位置。[/size]
[size=3]    4级农舍(解锁地窖):解锁通往地下室的楼梯(地下室里也可以摆放陈酿的木桶)，并在瀑布旁开设原版地窖的入口，同时解锁电梯功能.[/size]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]如何使用?[/size][/color][/b]

[size=3]你可以发现文件选项卡下面有三个文件，主文件就是农舍的文件和电梯功能所依赖的前置（都必须下载)，可选文件是我为PolyamorySweet制作的兼容配偶房文件，如果你使用PolyamorySweet，那务必下载(如果你不使用则可以忽略)，并将里面的文件覆盖到PolyamorySweet文件夹内(正确覆盖时系统会提示将4个地图文件覆盖掉，注意备份！)[/size]
[size=3]除此之外，你还需要下载SMAPI,CP,MMap(这是必须的，否则婴儿床位置会错乱),NoclipMode(穿墙mod),GMCM(非必须但强烈推荐),LetsMoveIt（非必须但强烈推荐）[/size]
[size=3]将文件和所需的前置下载完毕后，覆盖好兼容地图文件(如果你不使用PolyamorySweet则可以忽略)，将所有文件夹放入Mods文件夹即可.[/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]已知问题[/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]1.新建存档时，角色会生成在农舍左上方，这时你需要用到穿墙mod来回到正常的区域。[/size]
[size=3]2.每次房屋升级(除了最后一次开地窖)，家具、地图上的草、树等等这些后期自己放上去的东西会移位，所以每次升级前记得把地图先清空，特别是地图下方的东西，很容易偏移出地图边界然后消失找不回来；[/size]
[size=3]3.升级房屋或者更改本农舍的配置选项后，配偶房可能会短暂的消失，可以到下一天或者大退出游戏重新加载存档恢复正常；[/size]
[size=3]4.配偶每天早上的初始位置有时候会飘移到地图不可到达的角落里，可以用LetsMoveIt把配偶放到正常的地点;[/size]

[size=3]欢迎关注我的xhs@榴莲牛奶流心牛角包，如果你喜欢我的模组，可以投喂我一杯奶茶吗，也欢迎向我咨询模组定制服务，感激不尽ฅ ˃ ᵕ ˂ ฅ~[/size]
[size=3]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size]
[size=3]The Farmhouse Version of the Luxurious Large Villa: Now your spouse, pets, and children can live inside![/size]

[size=3]It is largely consistent with the PIF version, but with the following differences:[/size]
[size=3]1. Removed grass, trees, and shrubs from the path layer (because the path layer shifts and an extra layer appears during each house upgrade).[/size]
[size=3]2. Added background variants for rainy and snowy weather.[/size]
[size=3]3. Removed the greenhouse attribute and the buildable farm buildings attribute; fishing is no longer possible in the water bodies.[/size]
[size=3]4. Since other players reported severe lag with the previous full map when too many furnishings were placed, the farmhouse has been split into 4 parts. New map areas are unlocked progressively as the farmhouse level increases.[/size]
[size=3]5. Added two new shading options: one darker and the other lighter.[/size]

[b][color=#ff7700]Note: This mod makes slight adjustments to all spouse rooms to fit the room layout. If you are using other mods that alter spouse rooms, you can disable this mod's spouse room changes in the configuration options.[/color][/b]

[size=3]The farmhouse is now compatible with PolyamorySweet. When you use PolyamorySweet alongside this mod, a dedicated compatible map will be displayed after marriage. This compatible map can accommodate up to 6 spouse rooms (I've reserved 6 slots based on aesthetic design and map width limitations). You can take a wooden boat from the lake below to travel to the beach (and return via the same boat). A minecart warp point has also been added on the nearby heart island.[/size]

[size=3]If you do not use PolyamorySweet, the conventional style will be used.[/size]

[size=3]Each level of farmhouse upgrade unlocks new warp points and areas:[/size]
﻿[size=3]* Level 2 Farmhouse (Allows marriage): Unlocks the staircase leading up to the second floor and the terrace in the upper-right corner.[/size]
﻿[size=3]* Level 3 Farmhouse (Allows having children): Unlocks the staircase from the second floor to the third floor, the nursery next to the terrace, and           reserves a spot  for the elevator.[/size]
﻿[size=3]* Level 4 Farmhouse (Unlocks the cellar): Unlocks the staircase to the basement (where you can also place aging casks), opens the entrance to            the original  game's cellar by the waterfall, and activates the elevator function.[/size]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]How to Use?[/size][/color][/b]

[size=3]You'll find three files under the Files tab:[/size]
﻿[size=3]* The main file contains the farmhouse files and the required prerequisites for the elevator function (both must be downloaded).[/size]
﻿[size=3]* The optional file is the compatible spouse room file I made for PolyamorySweet. If you use PolyamorySweet, you must download this file (if               you don't use   PolyamorySweet, you can ignore it) and overwrite the files in your PolyamorySweet folder with it (when overwritten correctly,             the system will prompt you to  replace 4 map files – please back up your files first!).[/size] ﻿

[size=3]Additionally, you need to download the following mods:[/size]
﻿[size=3]* SMAPI, Content Patcher (CP), and MMap (essential, otherwise the crib position may be misplaced)[/size]
﻿*[size=3]NoclipMode (wall-passing mod).[/size]
﻿*[size=3] GMCM (highly recommended but optional).[/size]
﻿*[size=3] LetsMoveIt (highly recommended but optional).[/size]

[size=3]After downloading all the files and their prerequisites, and overwriting the compatible map files (if applicable), place all the folders into your Mods folder.[/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Known Issues[/b][/size][/color][b]
[/b]
[size=3]1. When starting a new save, the character may spawn in the top-left area of the farmhouse. You will need to use the wall-passing mod (NoclipMode) to return to the normal area.[/size]
[size=3]2. During each house upgrade (except the final one that unlocks the cellar), placed furnishings, grass, trees, etc., may shift positions. Therefore, remember to clear the map before each upgrade, especially items in the lower part of the map, as they can easily shift beyond the map boundaries and become lost.[/size]
[size=3]3. After upgrading the house or changing this farmhouse mod's configuration options, spouse rooms might temporarily disappear. This can usually be fixed by waiting until the next day or fully exiting and reloading the game.[/size]
[size=3]4. The spouse's initial position each morning might occasionally be misplaced in an unreachable corner of the map. You can use LetsMoveIt to move your spouse back to a normal location.[/size]
